punchline: Paul Jarvis grew his web business until he stopped doing the work he'd started it for, and then he scaled back.
thirty_sec: Paul Jarvis ran a growing web design business, and somewhere along the way his days turned into meetings, email and staff problems instead of design. He chose to scale back and work on his own. In Company of One he asks why anyone grows, and treats growth as a tool for the life you want rather than a goal in itself.
question: When did you last take on more at work, and what did it quietly replace?
